in_sanskrit.name: Anav
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Graceful, merciful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anav एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Anav is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anava', which means 'one who is merciful and graceful'. This name is associated with Lord Vishnu, the preserver in the Hindu Trimurti. The name Anav signifies humility, selflessness, and compassion.
